Each direction was considered against the complete current typed pool and assigned Japanese senses, not inferred from its reverse/transitive neighbours. Q does not erase broader senses: judicial regulation, engraved seals, arrival times, first items in rows and beneficial arrangements can share contexts without identifying the offered introductory meanings.

Consequential qualification, high confidence: kanji\割.md:11 retains 利 as distractor; :75 itself acknowledges gain. Whole JMdict 1606800 sense 3 gives 割り comparative profit/gain, while 1549460 gives 利 advantage/benefit/profit/interest. This is genuine lexical intersection, not merely an association. Division/share versus benefit remains a useful descriptive lesson contrast, but that does not make the bare glyph's benefit answer necessarily wrong. N023 operational suitability is U; preserve the historical source edge, record this qualification and do not activate it on this review's authority. No automatic new exclusion or semantic rewrite is recommended here.
N007 qualification: whole KANJIDIC 判/半 and current metadata share ハン; it is NOT a reading-mode guard. Semantic sуждение/печать versus половина contrast does not resolve a reading question.

Lesson and added-clarification decisions, in primary order:
L001=S, L002=S, L003=SQ, L004=S, L005=S, L006=S, L007=S, L008=S.
A001=S, A002=S, A003=SQ, A004=S, A005=S, A006=S, A007=S, A008=S.
S = supported in the exact source-text boundary; SQ = supported with explicit qualification, not acceptance. L003/A003 compressed author wording must not imply paper size is バン-only: whole JMdict 1478440 restricts seal/judgment to はん but allows paper/book size under both readings. Actual kanji\判.md:56–57 already states this correctly; no learner-text fix needed.
Evidence supporting the other decisions: 列 retains レツ/レ, with れっしゃ attested in 1558370; KanjiPedia extra kun do not invalidate source kun[]. 初's seven kun are accounted for, including auxiliary ichidan そめる (1342560) and post-ます-stem ぞめ first doing ever/in life/new year (2646830); a miss for 初染め proves no absence. 判る godan/intransitive/usual kana and 判子 ateji/usual kana are supported by 1606560/1478550. 利く/効く preferences are sense-specific (1591100), not bans; 利益 religious りやく is restricted (1549470). 到る/至る godan/intransitive is attested without an invented rarity label (1311870); 到着/到達 are intransitive suru, not necessarily intentional. 制御 includes machines, emotions and opponents (1595970). 刻む transitive godan, 刻み interval suffix, historical 刻 and 深刻 are supported by 1285890/1285840/1285820/1362730; 時間 is not asserted duration-only. 割る/割れる are transitive godan/intransitive ichidan, not deliberate/accidental or active/passive; 割く restrictions, 一割=10%, and 割合 noun/adverb distinctions match 1207730/1161440/1606810.

NAV dispositions, reader indices 0..7: [S,S,S,S,S,S,S,S] for words\便利.md, 初め.md, 初めて.md, 利用.md, 割れる.md, 割合.md, 最初.md, 評判.md respectively.
